description.value: A tiny rural reading room in Dome Creek, housed in a former public school alongside the Dome Creek Community Association. It offers books, DVDs, magazines, internet access, and community programs like a book club and children's events. For a touring cyclist on the remote Yellowhead Highway corridor, it's one of the few public indoor spaces between McBride and Prince George.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a small rural reading room (branch of McBride & District Public Library) located in Dome Creek, sharing space with the Dome Creek Community Association in a former school building. The website confirms high-speed internet access ('high speed internet access from two computers or your own device'), confirming Wi-Fi. Phone (250-553-2388) and address (13741 Dome Creek Road) are confirmed on the website. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Very limited opening hours — only three short windows per week, which may not align with cyclist arrival times
OSM opening hours differ from website hours (OSM: Thu 11-14, Fri 16:30-19, Sat 14-16:30; website: Thu 10:30-1, Fri 4:30-7, Sun 2-4:30)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Very limited opening hours (three short windows per week) and extremely remote location in Dome Creek. Valuable as one of very few public facilities on this stretch of highway, but the restricted hours significantly limit usefulness for touring cyclists passing through.

wow_evidence: Tiny rural reading room in a former school; ordinary library band.
blurb: Tiny reading room in a former schoolhouse at Dome Creek on Highway 16.
